title: perf: audit CI reuse and harden qualification evidence
body:
This draft makes the committed performance investigation and first correctness fixes reviewable while generator implementation continues.

Current head: `fb9963a45cce9259203c0d435766e6ae0ad76b89` on `perf/cache-selection-qualification`. Scope is the generator plus exactly 46 consumers, recorded in `scope.json` and the completion ledger.

Committed changes:

- Record bounded consumer/workflow/cache/obligation audits, immutable historical evidence identities, and every C01–C09 / T01–T26 completion gate.
- Add attempt-bound GitHub CI evidence collection and source-bound timeline analysis; reject incomplete terminal-job evidence and retain unknown measurements.
- Prepare actual Nextest test binaries and avoid irrelevant Rust bootstrap for repositories without Rust work.
- Reject self-gated validation obligations and validate bounded baseline proof lineage before accepting coverage.
- Stage exact committed owned-tool source blobs, patches, locks, licenses and action bundles with rejection of dirty sources, replacement and escaping symlinks; publication remains pending.

Validation and limits:

- Existing committed evidence records local experiments and prior independent reviews; those records are scoped evidence, not approval of the final integrated artifact.
- Opening this PR triggered [CI run 37070630165, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37070630165) for exact head `56924e5`. Cargo Machete failed because the committed orchestrator manifest adds an unused `zip` dependency ([job log](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37070630165/job/111048972406)). [Plan failed](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37070630165/job/111048972391) because committed `.github/workflows/ci.yml` differs from the candidate-source generated preview; its plan artifact was absent afterward. All eight Rust jobs were skipped. Actionlint, Alint, Cargo Deny and Zizmor passed. DCO passed. [Required failed](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37070630165/job/111049382285); baseline publication was skipped. Overall run conclusion: failure. This is committed-source CI, not validation of concurrent working-tree changes.
- The analyzer P2 workflow-source finding was fixed in [9a8daec](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/9a8daec9e7b54ce5c5bcb1b1b47e72cb930bf88b): authenticated push-only reconstruction, unsupported-event/reusable-graph rejection; 30 recorded regression tests pass. Baseline acquisition was bound to original immutable attempts in [f43b310](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/f43b310f9b4c05339bb471b0e712a7f0b2fe5173).
- [253bfb5](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/253bfb5a397d202e16d671e030fe730d07d2964a) removed the unused ZIP dependency until its consumer lands; exact locked metadata, Cargo Machete and Cargo Deny checks passed. [ce3c157](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/ce3c157a444e00db3148ca1885f533f91e700d1b) regenerated CI from the exact preceding committed source using the locked release CLI and two validated identical previews, updating eight Nextest preparation commands and task digests.
- Latest [CI run 37072404280, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37072404280) for `ce3c157` completed with failure. Its checkout was integration merge `f5d708aa5692d6123be8fa7d6da57c8dc70faa82`. Plan, Actionlint, Alint, Cargo Deny, Cargo Machete, Zizmor and DCO passed. [Orchestrator Format](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37072404280/job/111055070157) failed at `cover_baseline.rs:17` and `internal_request.rs:305`; the other seven Rust jobs failed Clippy at `contract/src/branch.rs:24` (`case_sensitive_file_extension_comparisons`). [Required](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37072404280/job/111055401075) failed; baseline publication skipped. These are historical committed-source CI failures, retained as regression evidence.
- [6209c06](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/6209c06d87c2f7e41ff162b77cc51e0c99989eec) fixes the Git branch suffix comparison while preserving its case semantics and formats the two failing orchestrator files. Recorded qualification includes 25 independent native Git cases and explicit Rust 1.98.1 gates. New [CI run 37075875245, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37075875245) completed with failure. Plan, all five static jobs, DCO and six Rust crate jobs passed. [Orchestrator Clippy](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37075875245/job/111065889616) fails `needless_pass_by_value` in `retrieve_planned_baseline_tests.rs:51`. [CLI Nextest](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37075875245/job/111065889728) fails the stale `multi-crate/ci.yml` golden (49628 expected bytes, 49720 actual; first difference 24419): 53 tests passed, one failed and 174 were not run under fail-fast. [Required](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37075875245/job/111066274947) failed; baseline publication skipped. These two failures remain open pending their separate fixes; the next head did not execute these Rust checks.
- [92fee746](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/92fee7465294af8f721319ccaec6d1308832d9df) establishes explicit native domain ownership boundaries in 18 committed files. Recorded local qualification covers nine focused proofs and independent documentation replay; this does not constitute hosted native qualification. Its distinct [CI run 37076151386, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37076151386) completed with failure: [Plan](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37076151386/job/111066406942) rejected stale generated CI after the source change; no plan artifact existed, [Required](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37076151386/job/111066713035) failed, eight Rust jobs and baseline publication were skipped. The five static jobs passed. Actual generator regeneration and fixture regeneration remain in progress.
- [d721e4f](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/d721e4ffe67cebfcfb0e57eb97fcbb90fd8068c2) updates the audit/completion ledger with source-bound closure and retained failed evidence. Its [CI run 37076978558, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37076978558) separately failed the same generated-workflow freshness gate; Required failed with absent plan artifact, eight Rust jobs and baseline publication skipped, and five static jobs passed. No Rust execution is claimed for this head.
- [3951c61](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/3951c613ecd59219a52d64b747b2191a44919dcc) regenerates the native ownership validation cohort. Its [CI run 37077289535, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37077289535) passed Plan and all static checks; seven Rust jobs passed, including [native ownership](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37077289535/job/111070218811) with 25/25 Nextest tests. Orchestrator Clippy still rejects metadata passed by value in the test helper at `retrieve_planned_baseline_tests.rs:51`; CLI Nextest still rejects the stale multi-crate golden (53 passed, one failed, 174 unrun). Required failed; baseline publication skipped. Hosted validation of the ownership boundary is limited to this native cohort, not full performance qualification.
- [d8d047c](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/d8d047cca366e21992a0f4f9c3c9eef3eacdff3a) borrows planned baseline test metadata; its intermediate run was cancelled when the next head arrived. [d017153](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/d0171536c2cd0b9240885aa8cbb44a11d916014a) regenerates actual affected parity fixtures. Its [CI run 37077760702, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37077760702) passed both prior blockers: orchestrator Clippy and CLI parity goldens. It still failed on two newly reached tests: [orchestrator](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37077760702/job/111072159576) reports `velnor-actions-native` unclassified at `matrix_step_tests.rs:350` (233 passed, one failed, 810 unrun); [CLI](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37077760702/job/111072159534) repository-policy integration reports freshness evidence older than the 24h contract (69 passed, one failed, 158 unrun). Plan/static checks and seven Rust jobs passed, Required failed, baseline skipped. These are the current open CI failures; performance qualification remains incomplete.
- [e2e6ff9](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/e2e6ff99a38de0e51c550eb9880d313c59990180) adds candidate build/download/behavior/evidence/immutable-publication scripts; no hosted tool qualification or release publication is established by their presence. Its run was cancelled by the next head after reproducing the prior two test failures. [8c383dc](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/8c383dc3a6d900a96302425f5790ec476ec2c5c3) records Python/uv/REUSE upgrade evidence. Its distinct [CI run 37078467065, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37078467065) failed: [Mise Clippy](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37078467065/job/111074005201) rejects unquoted `CPython` in `catalog.rs:86,133`; the same dependency blocks CLI and orchestrator Clippy before the prior test failures. Plan/static checks and six Rust jobs passed. Required failed; baseline skipped. The previous freshness-policy and native-classification test failures still require their own dispositions.
- [44d1600](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/44d16000c6b1e5812d8c3c02293d494a1d1f3451) fixes the catalog documentation lint. Its [CI run 37079434860, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37079434860) passed Clippy, Plan/static checks and six Rust jobs; three Rust test jobs failed. [Mise](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37079434860/job/111076855621) now reaches `catalog_identities_validate`, where the exact Python release URL's trailing slash is rejected as an empty segment before placeholder-digest validation (six passed, one failed, 331 unrun). CLI and orchestrator retain the prior freshness-policy and native-classification failures. Required failed; baseline skipped. All three failures require source-backed disposition.
- [43cd7de](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/43cd7de) defers release fixture changes until their dependencies are integrated, preserving the correction history. [6c110a9](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/6c110a9050b7f8af0fef72b2be85ed24e762146c) repairs suite classification through the reviewed registry (58 recorded focused tests and Clippy pass). [a83ecae](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/a83ecae7487f5858643715625b2de1b873e12e18) fixes source URL validation; its recorded Mise qualification passed 338 tests with one explicit network ignore. Its actual [CI run 37081005441, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37081005441) was cancelled by the next head; retained intermediate test passes do not establish a complete CI verdict. The live freshness-policy failure remains pending disposition.
- [49441b8](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/49441b8) changes the fallible root codec with 518 recorded focused tests/Clippy; [577694a](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/577694ab65150631cd318ef3819ba97c7a85f895) records independently inspected protection readiness. Its actual [CI run 37081167150, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37081167150) failed [Plan helper compilation](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37081167150/job/111082081481): the committed codec migration leaves five orchestrator consumers broken (`tofu_cache.rs:67,132`, `internal_plan.rs:62`, `matrix_tofu_env.rs:81`, `select_tofu.rs:73`). No helper/plan artifacts were available; Required failed, all nine Rust jobs and baseline publication skipped. Five static jobs passed. Focused codec tests do not prove the integrated generator builds.
- [b17d435](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/b17d4359fcd5ccb999222f05222bcf68d58068ab) adds reviewed source-tree object verification after source-only capsule/documentation units; publication/hosted qualification remains pending. Its distinct [CI run 37081970070, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37081970070) repeats the five known root-codec caller compile failures in Plan. Alint additionally failed before checking repository content because its pinned upstream archive download returned HTTP 500; this is separate from source violations. Four static jobs passed; Required failed, nine Rust jobs and baseline publication skipped. The bounded root-codec caller correction is still in local verification and is not part of this head.
- [5b4f9be](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/5b4f9be958e97acb1ec8034ada252fc54747e9ac) migrates every root identity caller and repairs mixed-stack root selection. Exact recorded local checks include full CLI compilation, CLI/orchestrator all-target Clippy, 412 orchestrator tests, 193 root tests and full CLI 227 passed with one retained freshness failure. Actual [CI run 37082833530, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37082833530) passed Plan helper compilation, all static checks and seven Rust jobs; Mise now passed 338 tests (one explicit network ignore), confirming the URL fix. Orchestrator fails formatting at `tests/impl_tofu_t27_reports_b.rs:86`; CLI retains the 17 stale-evidence failure (69 passed, one failed, 158 unrun). Required failed; baseline skipped. The prior five helper compile errors are resolved by actual hosted compilation; this run is still unsuccessful overall.
- [e0ba909](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/e0ba909ff2872b88e5752dccaf111cfb5c4573d3) applies the final assertion formatting fix. Its actual [CI run 37083184958, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37083184958) passes formatting/Clippy, Plan/static checks and seven Rust jobs. Orchestrator now reaches a validation failure fixture that uses the unclassified synthetic suite `demo`: `zizmor_staging::blessed_repo_tag_ref_still_fails` fails with `unclassified_repository_suite:demo` (413 passed, one failed, 638 unrun). CLI retains stale freshness evidence (69 passed, one failed, 158 unrun). Required failed; baseline skipped. The fixture must adopt a correctly classified identity without weakening unknown-suite rejection.
- [657c84f](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/657c84f7206fb04522176505e782899bcb698a26) aligns seven audited suite fixture files; recorded exact local qualification passed 1058 tests, Clippy and formatting. [fb9963a](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/commit/fb9963a45cce9259203c0d435766e6ae0ad76b89) closes the finite W0 audits across all 47 repositories while preserving every performance status as incomplete. Actual [CI run 37086452105, attempt 1](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37086452105) completed with failure. Plan/static checks and eight Rust jobs passed, including [orchestrator](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37086452105/job/111097941127) with 1058/1058 tests (537.950s, one slow). [CLI](https://github.com/tailrocks/velnor-new/actions/runs/37086452105/job/111097941205) alone failed among Rust jobs on the 17 stale freshness records (69 passed, one failed, 158 unrun). Required failed; baseline publication skipped. The suite fixture fixes now have exact hosted proof; integrated CI remains unsuccessful and performance qualification remains incomplete.
- Reviews, inline comments, issue comments and all review threads were refreshed at `fb9963a`; empty at inspection. Final terminal-run feedback refresh is complete for this exact head. Independent read-only review of `56924e5..ce3c157` confirmed P2 disposition and identified the same branch-grammar Clippy blocker; no further concrete finding in reviewed incremental scope. No independent tests were run by that reviewer.
- Exact Mise/Rust/MBX cache and selection fixes still in the working tree are outside this committed diff. No final generated workflow/runtime publication or consumer rollout is established here.
- Hosted cold/warm/third-run qualification remains pending. Every repository remains `INCOMPLETE`; no performance improvement, zero-download result, compiler-reuse result or percentile claim is made.

Keep draft until the integrated head has passed required deterministic gates, independent correctness/security/performance review and source-bound hosted qualification. Refresh all review comments, replies and unresolved/outdated threads at the final head before any merge. This PR does not authorize merging incomplete qualification.
